name: Socratic
description_en:
Socratic is a product in the Task management category. Its directory profile covers Time Tracking, Task Tracking, Reporting (Analytics), Progress Tracking.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $99.0. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: record time spent on selected work; summarize records and activity in reports and metrics. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
